description: This database is stored in SQLite database format and contains metadata of software packages, including licensing information, version release data, dependency details, and registry metadata.
Package ecosystem (e.g., NPM, Maven)
Package name
Version string of the package
License(s) associated with the package, stored as a JSON-like array
JSON-like list of relevant links (e.g., origin, documentation, source code)
JSON-like list of security advisories related to the package
JSON-like object with release metadata (e.g., `IsRelease`, `Ordinal`)
JSON-like list of file hashes
Whether dependencies have been processed successfully
Whether a dependency processing error occurred
Unix timestamp (ms) for when the upstream release was published
JSON-like list of registries where the package is published
SLSA provenance level if available
JSON-like list of upstream identifiers
Package URL in purl format (if available)
This database is stored in DuckDB format and contains GitHub project information and mappings between projects and their package versions. It is organized into two tables:
Package ecosystem (e.g., NPM)
Package name
Package version string
Type of project (e.g., GITHUB)
Repository path in `owner/repo` format
Provenance of the relationship data
Type of relationship (e.g., source repository type)
Textual description of the project (may include name, owner, and general purpose)
License(s) associated with the project, stored as a JSON-like array
Project description field (may differ from Project_Information)
Homepage URL of the project, if available
OSSFuzz status indicator (if applicable)
